definitions.explanation: Information (phone number, email, address) used to reach or communicate with someone.

examples.japanese: {連絡先|れんらくさき}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please give me your contact information.

examples.japanese: {連絡先|れんらくさき}を{交換|こうかん}した。
{緊急|きんきゅう}{連絡先|れんらくさき}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill in your emergency contact.

notes:
COMPOUND: {連絡|れんらく} (contact) + {先|さき} (destination, address)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {連絡先|れんらくさき}を{教|おし}える (give contact info)
- {連絡先|れんらくさき}を{交換|こうかん}する (exchange contact info)
- {連絡先|れんらくさき}を{記入|きにゅう}する (write down contact info)
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{連絡先|れんらくさき} (emergency contact)

INCLUDES:
- {電話番号|でんわばんごう} (phone number)
- メールアドレス (email address)
- {住所|じゅうしょ} (address)
- LINE ID, etc.
